Trust-region LP therefore has essentially nowhere to move, while random, orbit, or cap-deletion kicks either snap back to the same contact topology or destroy too much structure and re-anneal worse. The missing structural property is thus not looseness but a different, more equitable rigid contact topology—ideally one admitting balanced positive equilibrium stresses and/or an orbit/layer regularity that the present basin lacks.
